title: Short Illness Fatal To Mrs. W. T. Bibby
text:
Short Illness Fatal To Mrs. W. T. Bibby

SAVOY — Funeral services for Mrs. W. T. Bibby, 86, who died Tuesday in the home of her son, Pierce Bibby, after a week's illness, were to be held Wednesday at 2:30 p. m. in the Savoy Baptist Church, with burial in Sunnyside Cemetery.

Mrs. Bibby had lived in Savoy all her life, having been born here in 1867. She is survived by her husband, W. T. Bibby, three sons, S. A. Bibby, Kenneth Bibby and Pierce Bibby, all of Savoy; one daughter, Mrs. Laylah Baker of Savoy; one brother, C. C. Pierce of Lawrenceburg, Tenn., five grandchildren and two great grandchildren.

Pallbearers will be Earl Blakey, R. W. Wrenn, Doyle Withrow, Frank Baker, Ernest McCollum and Max Arterberry.
